title: Retained-head charts and the fixed resolution-word alphabet
statement: For an embedded rational resolution pair and any finite history H [def-trf-admissible-embedded-history], define the alphabet ResolutionWord as WithBot (DimensionHead ×ₗ MarkedIdeal.Word), using the normalized head space [lem-trf-hilbert-samuel-smooth-dimension-profile] and the fixed marked-ideal alphabet [lem-trf-marked-ideal-numerical-resolution-engine]. Define sumResolutionWord D to fix bottom and apply sumHead D to the head while leaving the tail unchanged. For a marked ideal, freshWordEmbedded replaces only its test boundary by the empty list, and freshWordMarked retains its support, ideal and marking. Define wordStageMap to be the final-to-stage map in the intrinsic diagram, and wordEarlierCenters by ordinary pullback of every preceding center kernel followed by appending the current extended kernel, retaining identity stages. A ResolutionWordChart R H x consists of a singularity proof at x and an engine-admissible marked-ideal history covering a consecutive suffix of H from the first occurrence of its current normalized head. It specifies etale intrinsic maps over Q, pointed transition squares, center-kernel pullback equalities, the ordered earlier ideals, the pullback of coefficientHistoryBoundary [def-trf-chronological-history-boundary], and birth k+1-index(0) with truncated subtraction. The initial fresh presentation is minimal, has the actual Hilbert--Samuel level, Presents and FullMaximalOrder; every suffix stage has maximal order and the retained normalized head. Its last cosupport point maps to the specified intrinsic point. Define its tail by dropping the first entry of R.value on that history and point, and its word by prefixing the normalized intrinsic head and adjoining it as a nonbottom word. These are data definitions, with no existence, comparison, finiteness or semicontinuity assertion.
